inputsAndSettings.prompt: Create one focused design reference for a GLITCH/MATRIX MATERIAL-ASSEMBLY refinement of this exact Seed-33 Paris cafe scene. Preserve its camera, composition, figure/object positions, and ALL fine architectural/furniture bead strands. The strands are approved: do not redraw, coarsen, recolor or restyle them. Keep the warm umber, ivory, peach, muted coral/honey/sage palette; no green Matrix rain or neon palette. Depict a mid-loading moment in which COLOR MATERIAL and RECTANGULAR OVERLAYS resolve as local digital bitfields, not smooth triangular wedges or alpha fades. In architectural and object surfaces, show fine ordered-dither cells, sparse scanline fragments, binary on/off pixel occupancy, broken local raster strips and small source-colored pixel islands connecting into material. Each material region has crisp irregular digital edges and empty gaps exposing intact underlying strands. Localized, controlled data corruption, not a full-frame square-grid wipe or static noise covering everything. Existing box groups at upper left, upper right and table gain glitchy matrix-like internal texture: subcells, dither toggles, tiny staggered slice offsets, short replicated edge ghosts, interrupted outlines, occasional solid-color blocks amid patterned ones. Box placements and visual hierarchy still match the source. Small bounded horizontal/vertical displacement, not big rotated panels, flying shards or broad decorative arcs. Preserve the person and object identity; no new architecture, text, labels, numbers or UI. This is a still design question about MATERIAL FILL and BOX INTERNALS only; the final fully settled source image remains the target. Clear beautiful technological disintegration-to-assembly with the approved strands continuously legible.

inputsAndSettings.prompt: Five-second fixed-camera motion study of GLITCHY MATRIX-LIKE COLOR FILL AND BOX OVERLAYS in this exact warm Seed-33 cafe. First and last frames are the same approved settled scene. Architectural and furniture bead strands must remain perfectly stable and visible throughout; do not change their paths, density, lighting or geometry. No figure walking or camera motion. Only material-color occupancy and box internals animate. From0.3s, small local color regions fracture into crisp ordered-dither bitcells and interrupted scanline fragments, leaving intact strands visible underneath. Digital color islands reconnect in short asynchronous stepped bursts, not a smooth alpha fade or broad triangular wipe. Rectangular source overlay groups at upper left, upper right and table have active matrix internals: subcell patterns invert briefly, local raster slices misalign by a few pixels and snap back, edge fragments duplicate briefly, small blocks appear/disappear in staggered clusters. Keep boxes near their existing bounds, no large translation or rotation. Digital signal reconstruction, restrained and legible rather than white-noise static. Different groups glitch at different times; hold each pattern long enough to read, no rapid high-contrast full-screen flashing. Warm coral, cream, honey and sage blocks on umber with ivory strands, never green Matrix rain. Across1-4s show distinct partial-dither, scanline-jitter and block-reassembly moments while preserving all objects and perspective. From4s, settle color bitcells and overlays back into the exact original source composition by5s. No text/numbers/UI. This study supplies temporal cues for replacing smooth coloring and box entry during loading; it does not authorize changing the approved strands or settled scene.
